target.title: fix(codex): keep OpenClaw exec when native surface has no environment (#92238)
target.body:
## Summary

Isolated cron jobs on the OpenAI/Codex runtime (gpt-5.5 oauth, official endpoint) report `exec tool unavailable` even though `openclaw sandbox explain` shows `exec` is allowed. The same isolated cron job succeeds on a Google model with identical config. Fixes #92238.

### Root cause

With the 2026.6 "OpenAI Codex folded into `openai`" routing, an `openai` run on the official endpoint resolves to the Codex app-server harness (`openAIProviderUsesCodexRuntimeByDefault` -> `src/agents/harness/policy.ts`), not the embedded Responses transport. Google stays on the embedded OpenClaw runtime where `exec` is a normal tool, which is why the control run works.

The Codex app-server strips OpenClaw's own `exec`/`process`/`read`/`write`/`edit`/`apply_patch` (`CODEX_APP_SERVER_OWNED_DYNAMIC_TOOL_EXCLUDES`) on the assumption that Codex owns shell natively. OpenClaw only ever registers a Codex execution environment through the sandbox exec-server (`environment/add` with an `execServerUrl`), and `shouldRequireCodexSandboxExecServerEnvironment` gates that on `sandbox.enabled`. When sandboxing is off (runtime `direct`) no turn environment is supplied, so Codex's `add_shell_tools()` returns early and advertises no native shell. Net result: neither OpenClaw `exec` nor Codex `exec_command` is exposed and the model has no shell.

Verified against the bundled `@openai/codex` `0.139.0` (`rust-v0.139.0`):
- `codex-rs/core/src/tools/spec_plan.rs:582` `add_shell_tools()` returns early at line 586 when `!environment_mode.has_environment()`.
- `codex-rs/core/src/session/turn_context.rs:168` `tool_environment_mode()` = `ToolEnvironmentMode::from_count(self.environments.turn_environments.len())` -> `None` with zero environments.
- `codex-rs/tools/src/tool_config.rs:175` `from_count(0) => None`; line 183 `has_environment()` is `false` for `None`.

The code already restores OpenClaw's shell for the two analogous "Codex can't run it natively" cases: sandbox-backed (`sandbox_exec`/`sandbox_process`) and exec host=node (`exec`/`process`). The sandbox-off / direct case was the missing fourth branch.

## Fix

`extensions/codex/src/app-server/dynamic-tool-build.ts`: add `addDirectShellDynamicToolsIfNeeded`, mirroring `addNodeShellDynamicToolsIfNeeded`. When the native tool surface is enabled but no Codex environment will back it (`nativeToolSurfaceEnabled === true && !sandbox.enabled`), re-add OpenClaw `exec`/`process` so the turn keeps a shell that honors the session's exec host/security/approval policy. Shared restore logic is factored into `restoreOpenClawShellDynamicTools`. No change when sandbox is on (Codex native `exec_command` runs via the registered exec-server environment), when exec host is `node`, or for memory-flush runs.

Sibling path: `/btw` side questions build their own tool set in `extensions/codex/src/app-server/side-question.ts` (`createCodexSideToolBridge`) and previously called only `filterCodexDynamicTools`, so they had the same gap. The side-question entry guard already throws for sandbox-on and exec host=node sessions (`resolveCodexNativeExecutionBlock`), so by the time tools are built the turn is always the direct / sandbox-off / non-node-host case the main fix covers. Side questions now call `filterCodexSideQuestionTools` (filter plus the same restore, gated on `!sandbox.enabled`), so they keep `exec`/`process` and still honor `codexDynamicToolsExclude`.

## Rebase notes (please read)

Rebased onto current `main`. Three things changed versus the first revision, all forced by `main` moving:

1. **`main`'s #104198 test expectations updated.** `expose selectable node exec` (#104198) added `exposes selectable node shell tools beside native shell for auto host runs`, which pins the exact tool list for the sandbox-off native-surface config this PR fixes. It asserted `["message", "node_exec", "node_process"]` for an auto-host run and `["message"]` for a pinned `host: "gateway"` run. Since no Codex environment is registered when sandbox is off, there is no native shell to sit "beside", and the `["message"]` case is exactly issue #92238 (a turn with no shell at all). Both assertions now include the restored `exec`/`process`; every #104198 intent assertion (node_exec presence/absence, description, parameter shape, host pinning) is unchanged. Flagging explicitly since it edits a just-landed test.
2. **New file `extensions/codex/src/app-server/node-shell-dynamic-tools.ts`.** The changed-file LOC ratchet (#106387) forbids growth in production files already over 500 lines, and both touched files are. The node-exec dynamic tool factories (`createNodeExecDynamicTool`, `createNodeProcessDynamicTool`, and their two private helpers) moved out verbatim, no behavior change, which keeps `dynamic-tool-build.ts` at 904 lines (base 936) and `side-question.ts` at 1322 (base 1324). Happy to reshape the split if you would rather it land elsewhere.
3. `restoreOpenClawShellDynamicTools` is no longer exported; `filterCodexSideQuestionTools` is the single export the side-question path consumes.

## Verification

- `node scripts/test-projects.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/dynamic-tool-build.test.ts extensions/codex/src/app-server/side-question.test.ts` -> 109 passed
- `node scripts/test-projects.mjs extensions/codex/src/app-server/run-attempt.test.ts run-attempt.dynamic-tools.test.ts native-execution-policy.test.ts thread-lifecycle.test.ts` -> 240 passed
- `pnpm check:loc --base origin/main` -> LOC ratchet clean on all three changed production files
- `pnpm check:import-cycles` -> 0 runtime value cycles
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions:test` -> clean

## Real behavior proof

Behavior addressed: an isolated-cron OpenAI/Codex run with sandbox off (provider `openai`, model `gpt-5.5`, host auto, no `toolsAllow`) is handed no shell at all, so the model reports `exec tool unavailable`; after the fix that same run gets a working `exec` that actually dispatches and runs a shell command.

Real environment tested: the production `buildDynamicTools()` driven with the REAL `createOpenClawCodingTools` factory (no stub, no injected tool list), with `nativeToolSurfaceEnabled` computed by the real `shouldEnableCodexAppServerNativeToolSurface` decision, then the resulting tool dispatched through the real Codex app-server bridge `createCodexDynamicToolBridge.handleToolCall`, which invokes the tool and spawns a real local OS process. Driven on pristine `main` @ `9619585e858f002f6007d806ba9d1b5fd913266f` and on PR head `b1f24943420a03f9ece66135ba14c9dc3f1c4901`, identical inputs.

Exact steps or command run after this patch: drove the production chain end to end (`buildDynamicTools()` -> `createCodexDynamicToolBridge.handleToolCall({ tool: "exec", callId: "exec-call-1", arguments: { command: "echo openclaw-92238-live-exec-ok" } })`) via a local driver under `node scripts/test-projects.mjs`, first with `dynamic-tool-build.ts` and `side-question.ts` reverted to pristine `main`, then with this patch applied, capturing the observed values to a file.

Evidence after fix:

```
# BEFORE (pristine main 9619585e8), real Codex bridge dispatch of `exec`:
nativeToolSurfaceEnabled=true
built tool names=["nodes","cron","message","tts","gateway","agents_list","get_goal","create_goal","update_goal","skill_workshop","sessions_list","sessions_history","sessions_search","sessions_send","sessions_spawn","sessions_yield","subagents","session_status","web_fetch","node_exec","node_process"]
exec present in built tools=false
bridge.success=false
bridge.output=Unknown OpenClaw tool: exec

# AFTER (this patch, head b1f2494342, identical inputs) -- a real local process is spawned:
nativeToolSurfaceEnabled=true
built tool names=["nodes","cron","message","tts","gateway","agents_list","get_goal","create_goal","update_goal","skill_workshop","sessions_list","sessions_history","sessions_search","sessions_send","sessions_spawn","sessions_yield","subagents","session_status","web_fetch","node_exec","node_process","exec","process"]
exec present in built tools=true
bridge.success=true
bridge.output=openclaw-92238-live-exec-ok
```

Observed result after fix: on the same inputs the turn goes from having no shell at all (`exec` absent from the built surface, and the bridge answering `Unknown OpenClaw tool: exec`) to exposing `exec`, dispatching it, and returning `openclaw-92238-live-exec-ok` from a real shell command run on the machine.

What was not tested: no live OpenAI/Codex provider request and no real cron scheduler run; the Codex app-server binary itself was not started, so the "Codex advertises no native shell without an environment" half of the root cause rests on the `@openai/codex` `0.139.0` source read quoted above rather than on a live app-server handshake. Full repo build not run.
